label: React Native
language: TypeScript on Node 22 (Expo managed or bare workflow; state which in tech.md)

structure.responsibility: screens and navigation (expo-router), or `src/screens/` in a bare app
structure.rule: screens compose features; no data access in a screen

structure.responsibility: one folder per feature: components, hooks, api
structure.rule: features import shared code, never each other
changed only for permissions, config, and native modules

notes: State in tech.md whether the project is Expo managed or bare; the dev and build commands differ (`npx expo` versus `./gradlew` and Xcode).
Native modules enter only through an approved dependency; check Expo compatibility first.
Secrets never ship in the JS bundle; use `expo-constants` extra or a native secret store.
`npx tsc --noEmit` at 0 errors and `npx eslint .` clean before a task is done.
